controles.affirmation: FedEx se defend dans des affaires d'employeur conjoint; une decision defavorable pourrait entrainer rappels de salaires, heures supplementaires, penalites, retenues fiscales et prestations sociales
controles.verbatim_source: We are defending joint-employer cases where it is alleged that we should be treated as an employer or joint employer of the drivers employed by service providers with whom we contract... adverse determinations in these matters or regulatory developments could, among other things, entitle service providers' drivers to certain wage payments and penalties from the service providers and us, and result in wages, overtime, penalties, withholding tax and benefits, and other employment-related liabilities for us. The status of the drivers employed by these service providers could be further challenged in connection with Network 2.0 transformation. (10-K FY2026, Item 1A)

controles.affirmation: Contentieux fiscal sur la taxe de transition, audience d'appel du 30 juillet 2026, benefice cumule de 249 M$ deja comptabilise
controles.verbatim_source: We have recorded a cumulative benefit of $249 million... On August 1, 2025, the government filed a notice to appeal the decision to the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Sixth Circuit... Oral arguments are scheduled for July 30, 2026. If we are ultimately unsuccessful in defending our position, we may be required to reverse the benefit previously recorded.

controles.affirmation: Suppression de l'exemption de minimis: frais de courtage douanier accrus; les changements de politique commerciale pourraient reduire significativement le volume mondial
controles.verbatim_source: Other operating expense increased 9% in 2026 primarily due to credit losses from higher revenue and impacts from global trade policy changes, increased outside service contracts and professional fees, and customs-related brokerage fees due to the removal of the de minimis exemption.

controles.affirmation: Notations BBB (S&P) et Baa2 (Moody's), deux crans au-dessus du speculatif; passer sous investment grade limiterait l'acces aux marches de capitaux
controles.verbatim_source: Standard & Poor's has assigned us a senior unsecured debt credit rating of BBB... Moody's Investors Service has assigned us an unsecured debt credit rating of Baa2... If our unsecured debt or commercial paper ratings are reduced to below investment grade, our access to the capital markets may become limited.

controles.affirmation: Amazon a construit hubs/avions/vehicules, lance un service LTL et ouvre ses capacites de livraison a des tiers
controles.verbatim_source: Amazon has established a network of hubs, aircraft, and vehicles, recently began offering an LTL freight service for inbound shipments to its distribution facilities, and recently began offering its internal delivery capabilities broadly to third parties.
